title: Manpower Plannings — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: The headcount a department is asking for over a planning period: one line per job title with a monthly budget. A department can have one plan per period. The plan goes to approval, which needs a period and at least one line; the approver sees the department, period and amount. When it is approved, a vacant, budgeted position is created for every line that does not already have one.
